name: citation.is
description: Open registry of verified scientific claims. Search 3,900+ claims from structural biology, salmon biotech, and more. Every claim is cross-referenced against UniProt, PubChem, NCBI Taxonomy, and PubMed.

authentication.description: No authentication required. All endpoints are publicly accessible.

skills.name: Search Scientific Claims
skills.description: Search the registry for verified scientific claims by keyword, entity name, or claim text. Returns structured claim objects with verdict, evidence, and entity links.
examples: Search for claims about PCNA protein
Find verified claims mentioning salmon lice

skills.name: Verify a Scientific Claim
skills.description: Submit a scientific claim text for verification against the registry and authoritative databases. Returns a verdict (SUPPORTED, REFUTED, UNVERIFIED) with evidence.
examples: Verify: PCNA forms a homotrimeric ring structure
Is it true that salmon lice develop resistance to Ivermectin?
